title: Find the failed request in a very long log
prompt: The application wrote its log to logs/app.log (about 200,000 lines). Exactly one request ended with status 500. Write its request id (it looks like req-1a2b3c4d5e6f) into answer.txt, alone on one line.
setup:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, os, random
random.seed(7)
secret = os.environ["BENCH_SECRET"]
want = "req-" + hashlib.sha1((secret + "id").encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
os.makedirs("logs", exist_ok=True)
paths = ["/api/users", "/api/orders", "/api/items", "/health", "/login"]
other = [("404", 0.02), ("502", 0.001), ("400", 0.01), ("401", 0.005)]
bad = random.randrange(150000, 199000)
with open("logs/app.log", "w") as f:
    for i in range(200000):
        rid = "req-%012x" % random.getrandbits(48)
        p = random.choice(paths)
        status = "200"
        roll = random.random()
        acc = 0
        for s, w in other:
            acc += w
            if roll < acc:
                status = s
                break
        level = "INFO" if status == "200" else ("WARN" if status[0] == "4" else "ERROR")
        if i == bad:
            rid, status, level, p = want, "500", "ERROR", "/api/orders"
        f.write("2026-11-19T10:%02d:%02dZ %s %s %s %s %dms\n" % (i // 3600 % 60, i % 60, level, rid, p, status, random.randint(1, 900)))
EOF
